versions.text: (a) This speed shall not exceed the lesser of the following: (1) The design flap speed, V;, chosen in accordance with § 3.190. (2) The design flap speed chosen in accordance with § 3.223, but shall not be less than the minimum value of design flap speed permitted in §§ 3.190 and 3.223. (b) Additional combinations of flap setting, air speed, and engine power may be established, provided the structure has been proven for the corresponding design conditions.
